expectations.headers: Actual MCP initialize and tools/list requests carry exact static/environment headers and bearer from declared environment reference. Environment headers override static names, bearer overrides Authorization. Invalid or absent values fail closed.
expectations.scope: Host metadata contains routing/source hashes only. Re-read declaration before connect; reject changed URL/name/config and redirect credential forwarding. No global credential cache or Codex login token access.
expectations.oauth: Validate and retain public legacy OAuth client/scopes/callback fields and public per-HTTP-server extensions.com.openai.auth none/oauth/mixed/api_key fields. Explicit empty/default scopes and false remain intact. No login or secret is granted by a declaration. OAuth/API-key setup needs separate host interaction/connection; mixed permits anonymous access. Private/enterprise modes rejected.
expectations.differences: Unlike snapshot warning-and-skip header resolution, unknown environment references and invalid headers are fatal. Credentials require HTTPS except loopback; transport-owned headers cannot be overridden. Plugin redirects are disabled.
